summary.text: Stephen Boyle is the Green Party candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as technology consultant, and he has run for office before as a Green Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Stephen Boyle graduated from Bishop Foley High School and Wayne State University and earned a graduate degree from Walsh College in 2005.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Boyle said he grew up in Royal Oak from 1970, earned a computer science degree at Wayne State and worked in corporate computing in downtown Detroit for 20 years.

Boyle was the Green Party candidate for Michigan House District 3 in 2020, receiving 2.7% of the vote in a race won by Shri Thanedar, and for Wayne County Commission District 5 in 2024, receiving 4.1% in a race won by incumbent Irma Clark-Coleman.
He was nominated for District 8 at the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026.
In the 2024 survey, Boyle listed transportation, environment, housing, food, water, education and justice as policy areas he is passionate about.
